claude.sample_unit: clinical cases (each synthesized with 36 voice profiles)

links.outcome: Audio LLM surgical recommendations varying by voice age, gender, emotion versus identical text inputs
links.effect: Surgical recommendations for audio varied by up to 35% versus text; age disparities up to 12% between young and elderly voices, persisting in most models despite chain-of-thought prompting.
links.quote: Further analysis uncovered age disparities of up to 12% between young and elderly voices, which persisted in most models despite chain-of-thought prompting.

links.outcome: Clinical recommendation shifts under audio input variation versus text
links.effect: Surgical recommendations for audio inputs varied by as much as 35% compared to identical text-based inputs, with one model providing 80% fewer recommendations.
links.quote: Our findings reveal a severe modality bias: surgical recommendations for audio inputs varied by as much as 35% compared to identical text-based inputs, with one model providing 80% fewer recommendations.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought prompting to mitigate demographic voice bias
